facts.fact: WIOCC/OADC state that 2Africa is landed at the open-access, carrier-neutral OADC Durban in Amanzimtoti, where service providers can access international capacity on a fair and equitable basis.

systems.owner: 2Africa consortium (China Mobile International, Meta, MTN GlobalConnect, Orange, center3, Telecom Egypt, Vodacom, WIOCC)

note: 2Africa landings (Amanzimtoti, Yzerfontein, Duynefontein, Gqeberha) not yet in service (Amanzimtoti East RFS Q4 2023); METISS lands at Amanzimtoti but is not stated as in service.
